data: Amazon was the larger company by revenue in fiscal 2025, reporting total net sales of $716.9 billion for the year ended December 31, 2025 ($716,924 million), compared with Apple's net sales of $416.2 billion for the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025 ($416,161 million). That makes Amazon about 1.72 times as large as Apple, a gap of roughly $300.8 billion. Note that the two fiscal years end at different times, with Apple's closing about three months before Amazon's.
